title: Boho Enclave (4 bedrooms, sleeps 10 comfortably)
description:
This newly furnished home boasts a prime location just 2 miles from Downtown, Broadway, Top Golf, Nissan Stadium, and more! Perfect for quality time with family or friends, it offers 3 bedrooms plus an extra sleeping area, a well-equipped kitchen with a complimentary coffee bar, and a generous fenced backyard complete with a cozy fire pit for gatherings. Welcome to Music City!

The space
This recently remodeled 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers ample accommodation for up to 8 guests. Elegantly adorned, it features a delightful living area, a charming dining space adjacent to a well-appointed kitchen, and a secluded fenced backyard with a cozy deck and fire pit. Details of the bedrooms are provided below:

Sleeping arrangements:
Bedroom 1: King sleeps 2 - Coral Couch folds out easily to become a queen
Bedroom 2: King sleeps 2
Bedroom 3: King sleeps 2
Bedroom 4: Twin Bunk Bed sleeps 2

Guest access
You have access to the entirety of the home!
